pages.excerpt: Trenchless sewer and water line repair in Spokane: sewer lining, pipe bursting, water line pulling and point repairs. Family-owned, camera footage you keep.
pages.content:
Sewer backing up, or water pressure dropping? We fix sewer and water lines across the Spokane metro area, including Spokane, from the inside, through small access points instead of a trench across your yard.

PNW Trenchless is family-owned and run by Mike Jeisma, who has spent 14+ years in sewer and water line work across the Spokane area. Every job starts with a camera inspection: you see what we see, and you get a true and honest quote in writing before any work begins.

Sewer and water line problems we see in Spokane

Many older Spokane-area homes still run on clay, cast iron or Orangeburg sewer lines and galvanized water service. Add mature pines and maples, and root intrusion is one of the most common problems we see.

  • Roots in the line: backups that keep coming back after the line is cleared.
  • Cracked or collapsed pipe: old clay and Orangeburg lines past their life.
  • Low water pressure: often a corroded galvanized water service.
  • One bad spot: a single crack or joint on an otherwise good line.

Mike, 2–3 sentences about Spokane: neighborhoods, soil, how deep lines run, what he finds most often.

{{img:860}}

Our trenchless services in Spokane

Sewer pipe lining

A resin liner cures inside your old pipe, creating a seamless, jointless pipe within a pipe. No trench, and no joints for roots to find. More about sewer pipe lining

Pipe bursting

A bursting head breaks the old pipe outward while new HDPE pipe is pulled in behind it. A completely new pipe with a 50+ year lifespan, and it can be upsized. More about pipe bursting

Water line pulling

We pull a new CTS poly line underground, reconnect it, and test it for pressure and leaks. No rust or scale buildup, and better water pressure. More about water line pulling

Point repairs

When the damage is isolated to one section and the rest of the pipe is sound, we reline just that spot instead of replacing the whole line. More about point repairs

How a trenchless repair works

  1. Camera inspection. We record the full line and show you the footage.
  2. Written quote. The method that fits your pipe, and the price, before any work.
  3. The repair. Lining, bursting, a new water line or a point repair, through one or two small access points.
  4. Final camera run. Proof the line is fixed. You keep the before and after footage.

Trenchless or digging?

With a traditional dig you also pay to restore everything that came out of the ground. Trenchless repair leaves your lawn, driveway and trees in place in most cases, and your water or sewer is off for hours, not days.

Trenchless isn't right for every pipe. If a section has a belly or is out of grade, digging that spot may be the better fix, and we'll tell you so.
